name: – Commission proposal
title: Shipments of waste: export of mixed municipal waste for recovery to Switzerland ***I
part_text:
The Commission is proposing a rule for trucks and buses: their pollution limits would be allowed to rise by 20% once a vehicle passes its main lifetime and enters the extra period. This is called a "durability multiplier". The Commission studied older diesel vehicles because new ones are not on the roads yet. It found 1.2 fits both lighter and heavier heavy-duty vehicles, matching the value already set for cars and smaller buses.

- **What changes:** Pollution limits for trucks and buses may be multiplied by 1.2 in the extra lifetime period.
- **Who it affects:** Makers of heavy trucks, lighter trucks, city buses and coaches.
- **What happens next:** The Commission will set this value in the rules, using its existing powers.
